title: Digital Root Calculator
description: Reduce any number to its digital root by repeated digit sums, with every step shown.
howto: Follow each digit-sum step down to the single-digit root.

faqs.a: The single digit you get by repeatedly adding a number’s digits: 9875 → 29 → 11 → 2.
Yes: digital root = 1 + (n−1) mod 9 (and 9 when n is a multiple of 9). The tool verifies it by casting out nines.
How many digit-sum rounds it takes to reach one digit — shown alongside the root.
